profile.headline: CCM Developer SME
profile.summary:
Specialties: Quadient Inspire, EMC xPression, xPression xDesign, xPression xAdmin, Adobe   Dreamweaver, Adobe Photoshop, PilotFish, MS Office Suite, Lotus Notes, MS Front Page, InfoPath, SharePoint, VISIO, Crystal Reports, Essbase, SAS, Visual Source Safe, Fiserv PolicyStar, CSS, HTML/XHTML, PHP, XML/XSL, Visual Basic, VBA, Microsoft Scripting Language, IBM DB2, MySQL, 
Oracle, SQL, MS Windows

positions.title: Software Engineer IV - Quadient Developer
positions.description: Responsible for developing and enhancing enterprise CCM solutions using Quadient Inspire. Work includes template composition, data mapping, business rule implementation, and integration with print/digital output workflows. Leverage 20 years of CCM and document design experience to improve communication accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Analytical Skills · Microsoft Office · VBA · XML · XML Databases · Quadient Inspire

positions.title: Sr business systems analyst
positions.description: Skills: Business Analysis · Data Analysis · Requirements Analysis · Agile Methodologies · Analytical Skills

positions.title: xPression Developer
positions.description:
Developed Line of Business DECs, Amendment forms, rating worksheets, quote proposals, ID Cards, and other complex policy forms 
Data model SME to ensure xPression performance
Work with companies to analyze systems for gap analysis, business processes, system requirements, and budget impacts
Provided mentoring, coaching and training to business and technical staff on xPression xDesign and xAdmin.  
Liaison between the following business areas supporting the insurance policy development & print end to end process: policy application developers, line of business lead product development analysts, data systems analysts, data architects, business analysts, and management  
Track and monitor requests to ensure timely resolution
Support applications by reviewing, analyzing, testing and debugging software including enhancements and functionality prior to rolling out to department
Identify, research and resolve technical problems

Technical Proficiencies:
xPression xDesign
xPression xAdmin
PilotFish
Fiserv PolicyStar
Microsoft Office 
SQL
XML
PHP
HTML
VB
VBA

positions.title: xPression System Specialist
positions.description:
Lead xPression Administrator and expert using xPression xDesign 2.1 and 2.5
Designed and developed xPression data model
Created xslt programs to transform policy Accord xml to efficient xPression xml
Managed vendor relationships between the business and technical staff
Oversaw small teams in development and implementation of xPression solutions to include project management (including resource allocation, project planning, forecasting, and client management)
Reviewed, analyzed, tested and debugged xPression enhancements and functionality before implementing into development, testing and production environments.  
Provided day to day administration of xPression.
Worked with companies to analyze systems for gap analysis, business processes, system requirements, and budget impacts
Provided mentoring, coaching and training to business and technical staff on xPression xDesign and xAdmin.  
Provide technical consultation and expertise to the organization
Track and monitor requests to ensure timely resolution
Identify, research and resolve technical problems
Write technical documentation for both technical and business users
Lead initiatives of disaster recovery and financial system interfacing with banks on behalf of the companies.
Develop applications in support of internal applications

Technical Proficiencies:
xPression xDesign
xPression xAdmin
PilotFish
Fiserv PolicyStar
Microsoft Office

VBA

Provided websites, custom applications and custom PC work to small businesses. 

Technical Proficiencies:
-Web Design
-DreamWeaver
-FrontPage
-VB Programming
-VB .net Programming
-Microsoft Products
-Hardware diagnostics and repair

positions.title: Programmer Analyst – Application Development
positions.description:
Developed end user applications that increase productivity and serve the needs of our members.  
Provided support to various customer groups to include Claims, Underwriting, Policy Service, General Agency, Member Services, Bank, Life, Investment Management Company and Enterprise Business Operations.  
The rapid development projects included analysis of data sources and business processes, development and negotiations of specification and were generally built utilizing Microsoft products.

Technical Proficiencies :
All Microsoft data reporting and retrieval tools (Access, Excel, FrontPage, InfoPath, SharePoint Services, VISIO, Outlook and Word).  
VBA 
VB.Net
VB Script
Microsoft Scripting language
SQL
Relational database design and development 
Crystal Report
Interfacing with SQL databases, DB2, Essbase, SAS, Crystal Reports, and our data warehouse

Other Duties and Skills:
Software Implementation
Business process redesign and engineering
Project management of complex business solutions 
Provided mentoring, and coaching in USAA and industry standards for application development and implementation of junior level analysts and across the enterprise.
Subject Matter Expert in specific areas of investigation, data gathering and analysis
Point of Contact for senior management of various business areas in support of their automation needs
Provide assistance and technical support for the development of reporting for new metrics for performance evaluation 
Investigated and resolved data and system inconsistencies
Ensured applications meet the Enterprise standards for information security classification guidelines (confidential and restricted information levels)

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst
positions.description:
Interface with customer to provide PC support to include hardware and application support.

Performed maintenance and upgrades to hardware and softwware

Development of Reporting and Tracking database for customer issues and resolutions

Technical Proficiencies:
VBA
Microsoft Products
Hardware diagnostics and repair
Operating System expertise (Microsoft Windows)

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Designed and implemented tracking log for claims and policy changes or additions.
Documented claims and prepared appropriate paper work for filing
Performed and analyzed policy changes
Processed new policies and changes to policies
Assisted in development of marketing analysis and plan

positions.title: District Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for overall operations and personnel for 4 stores and 40 employees.
Maintained company computer systems to include upgrading system components and software
Hiring and development of staff

Problem resolution and negotiation with customers and staff
